newsitem.title: GERMANY: New airmail centre opens at Frankfurt airport.
newsitem.headline: New airmail centre opens at Frankfurt airport.

text.p: A new 40 million mark international post centre has gone into operation at Frankfurt airport.
The 10,000 square metre Airmail Center Frankfurt (ACF) will handle the 140 tonnes of international and domestic post passing through Frankfurt each day.

Speaking at the World Express & Mail conference in Frankfurt, ACF joint managing director Thomas Hoehl said the new centre could sort up to 11,000 items per,hour, including letters, parcels and mailbags, and would speed up handling.
A state-of-the-art sorting system meant mail could be loaded directly from and back to airlines and the Deutsche Post AG international post centre, he added.

The ACF is a joint venture between Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG), the airport owner and operator, Lufthansa Cargo AG and Deutsche Post AG. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
